status: frozen before any non-Tadarida calibration outputs were opened
trigger: Tadarida post-freeze calibration showed a non-zero estimator null and strong sensitivity of ordinary marginal identity to horizontal cell weighting.

common_design.preserve: exact per-cohort number of retained sessions assigned to every original individual label, plus all within-session x-y-z data and coverage
common_design.common_cell_reweighting: identical to tadarida_estimator_calibration_v1: equal-session self cell-frequency weights over conditional common-support cells applied to both self and other P(z|cell)

reported_metrics: lower-tail P(null <= observed) for diagnosing marginal-dominant/negative architecture

interpretation_rules.no_raw_sign_classification: Do not call a panel conditional- or marginal-dominant from uncalibrated G_adv sign alone.
interpretation_rules.standardized_architecture: Primary diagnostic comparison across panels is the calibrated common-cell advantage: observed common-cell advantage minus that panel's permutation-null mean; report raw common-cell advantage alongside it.
interpretation_rules.robust_conditional_evidence: Requires calibrated common-cell advantage > 0 and one-sided permutation tail <= 0.05. Bootstrap interval is reported but is not a second pass/fail gate.
interpretation_rules.marginal_dominance_check: For Phyllostomus 2022, specifically test whether common-cell weighting and panel-specific null calibration remove, preserve, or reverse the negative architecture.

stop_rule: Do not alter B, seeds, cohort scope, reweighting, bins, grid, smoothing, or eligibility after any non-Tadarida calibration output is opened.
Retain negative and contradictory panel results.
If the original architecture categories change after calibration, amend the manuscript before submission.
